text: Evening. Looking after my grandson Tomas tonight, he's 9. His eczema has flared up, dry rough patches on the backs of his knees and inside his elbows, and he keeps scrathing at them. I think his mum usualy puts a cream on but I'm not sure which one, and I can't get hold of her. Is there anything I can use in the meantime to calm the itching so he gets some sleep.
